definitionZh: *scroll-按钮() CSS伪元素代表一个控制滚动容器滚动的按钮. 当其内容值不是零时,它们就会在滚动容器中产生。 滚动的方向由参数值决定.
sourceDefinition: The ::scroll-button() CSS pseudo-element represents a button for controlling the scrolling of a scroll container. They are generated on scroll containers when their content value is not none. The direction of the scrolling is determined by the parameter value.
